title: Abyssals v0.90.12 — Marasen streets and stocked Exchange
notes: Marasen’s districts now connect through visible open-air streets rather than freestanding doorway portals. Every exterior building has an entrance: the Seed Exchange is restored in Seven Bridges and the Rapids Arena has a race hall. Six Exchange floors receive individual transparent 3D-style potion cases, armour cabinets, colourful codex bookshelves, carved counters and marble staircases, with shared furniture/stair collision and broad clear aisles. Original architectural detail is reused only outside walkable floor space. Existing saves, quests, permanent deaths, unique encounters and the original Android package/certificate are preserved. Automated geometry, save recovery and live Chromium interaction checks run before the signed GitHub Actions release. No physical-phone installation test claimed.
